name: spec-syncer
description: Infer impacted ADS specs from a task, changed paths, and linked change proposal, then optionally write spec-delta.md.

task_path.description: Path to the ADS task markdown file

changed_paths.description: Optional changed paths. If omitted, the script uses task related paths as hints.

spec_delta_output.description: Optional output path for a generated spec-delta markdown file
